# React production fixture

Unmodified MIT-licensed UMD production builds from the official npm packages
`react@18.3.1` and `react-dom@18.3.1`. Both original LICENSE files are retained.
These assets are served only by loopback test fixtures, not embedded in Vector.
Tests make no network requests to download dependencies.

Sources:
- https://registry.npmjs.org/react/-/react-18.3.1.tgz
- https://registry.npmjs.org/react-dom/-/react-dom-18.3.1.tgz

- `react.production.min.js`: `d949f1c3687aedadcedac85261865f29b17cd273997e7f6b2bfc53b2f9d4c4dd`
- `react-dom.production.min.js`: `35f4f974f4b2bcd44da73963347f8952e341f83909e4498227d4e26b98f66f0d`
